title: corydalis pauciflora f. albiflora
intro: Corydalis pauciflora f. albiflora, commonly known as White Corydalis, is a variant of the Corydalis plant species. It is a flowering plant native to the alpine regions of the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Corydalis pauciflora f. albiflora include berberine, tetrahydroprotoberberine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
